text:
Alex: heads-up — CI perf alert on nightly-perf-ci: p95 small-batch latency ~2.1x at 03:12 UTC. Dashboard: https://dashboard.redwood.example/perf/246000 — looks timed with kernel-sched merge. cc @Priya @Zhou

Priya: which job/run id?

Alex: nightly/run/bench-smallbatch-2460000010

Zhou: pulling the flamegraphs now, give me 3–5 mins.

eng-ci-bot: Alert: p95_latency=480ms (baseline 220ms), error_rate=0.2% — triggered at 03:12:07 UTC

Sophie: can you paste the perf job args? did we change batch sizes or seq length knobs?

Alex: no batch config changes. Only notable merge last night: kernel sched tweak (commit 6a9f3d). No model changes.

Tariq: I can try a local repro with same model + seq. Alex, drop the run id + snapshot + trace link?

Alex: run id + trace: https://traces.redwood.example/trace/0d3a — logs: `kubectl logs job/bench-smallbatch-2460000010 -c runner`

Zhou: quick snippet from the trace/heatmap:
```
[2026-03-17T03:12:09Z] runner: scheduling delay=85ms thread=runtime-main
[2026-03-17T03:12:10Z] runtime: kvcache stall detected, stall_time=70ms
[2026-03-17T03:12:11Z] model-serving: token_emit=12ms
```

Priya: hmm scheduling stalls look real. The kernel patch had a preempt threshold change and went to canary yesterday (flag: sched_opt). Who flipped the flag to 100%?

Sophie: ops confirmed canary->100% at 00:40 UTC as part of rollout.

Tariq: proposal: flip sched_opt back to false on canary/dedicated pools (quick rollback) and watch p95 for 10m. Ops needs coordination window.

Alex: agreed. If rollback is approved, I'll coordinate and run baseline job after. I'll also open a bisect ticket.

eng-ci-bot: Incident ticket created: INC-4821 (owner: Alex)

Zhou: if rollback fixes it, we should run a binary search on the kernel commits (perf-bisect job). I can start bisect once we confirm.

Priya: I'll update the runbook: steps for rollback, how to gather traces (`kubectl cp` + `perf collect`), and contact list (SRE/Ops/Triage). :thumbsup:

Sophie: Ops can do a short maintenance window, 5m. @Tariq can you coordinate the toggle at ~03:45 UTC?

Tariq: yep I'll flip it and watch metrics. Posting here when done.

Alex: will be standing by to run the smoke bench after toggle.

Tariq: toggled sched_opt=false at 03:47 UTC (canary pool).

Alex: smoke bench run started at 03:49 UTC, p95 down to 210ms (baseline ~220ms).

Sophie: great — if stable for 30m we can close the incident and mark the kernel change as blocked until bisect completes.

Alex: filing short postmortem and adding links to traces + runbook edits. Will follow up with list of next steps (bisect owner, revert timeline).

Priya: thanks everyone. Logged notes into the runbook and INC-4821.

Zhou: starting perf-bisect job now (job id perf-bisect-2460000105). I'll paste results once ready.

Alex: update: incident marked resolved for now — will keep monitoring overnight.

Sophie: thanks — please ping #all-hands if anything changes.
